item.text: The crash is from the `DATABASE_URL` check: the configured URL uses `postgress://`, while the app accepts `postgres://` or `postgresql://`. The failure path also prints the full config, including credentials, so I’m checking the local setup before fixing both issues.

item.text:
`npm start` failed because the local `.env` used `postgress://` instead of `postgres://` for `DATABASE_URL`. I corrected it and updated [src/server.js](/home/node/shop-api/src/server.js:8) so an invalid URL no longer causes credentials to be printed.

Verified: `npm start` now exits successfully; an invalid URL produces a clear error. The current code prints “listening on :3000” but does not create an HTTP server.
